slides.title: Key considerations

points.lead: Is the plan worth more than a sale?
points.text: Compare the stand-alone DCF with what buyers can pay today.
Two tier-1 strategics overlap Halden's hubs and could pay for the savings.

points.text: A sponsor offers speed; a strategic may need antitrust review.

points.lead: What would a process cost the business?
points.text: A short process with a small, tiered buyer list limits disruption.

slides.title: Recommendation and next steps

points.text: Run a targeted sale process to the two tier-1 strategics and Sponsor D, keeping the stand-alone plan as the walk-away.
Most valuation ranges sit above today's price, the tier-1 strategics can pay for hub savings, and a tiered list limits disruption.
Board approval of the process; advisers prepare the teaser and management presentation; outreach starts in September.

slides.title: Disclaimer
slides.text: These materials were prepared for the Board's use in reviewing strategic alternatives. They rely on public information and on projections prepared by management, which we have not verified independently. They are preliminary and illustrative, are not a valuation opinion, and are not a recommendation to any shareholder. The company and figures are fictional.
